scope: Três novos portadores propostos; grupo permanece aberto.

creatures.name: Nimbálio
creatures.architecture: Aéreo, sem patas, com duas grandes membranas laterais.
creatures.story: Propõe-se um portador que sustenta caminhos de vento sem tocar o chão.
creatures.tradeoff: Ao fechar as membranas para proteger o cristal, perde área de sustentação.
creatures.review: Duas membranas com raízes no tórax, nenhum membro de caminhada e uma rabiola completa. Cristal no eixo frontal abaixo da cabeça, três apoios e canais para raízes das membranas. Olhos ciano. Não é prova física de voo.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. Create ONE original adult SOULMONSTER NIMBALIO, proposed bearer of the CRYSTAIS PIPAS, an ancient AIRBORNE creature with NO walking legs. Reference1 is our original crystal sheet: copy the same artifact identity and three-prong mounting. Reference2 original Vesperalito: 2D manga ink/cel finish and rich armor density only, do not copy body, head or palette.
Unique anatomy is a living floating SKY-RAY / ceremonial kite canopy: massive broad central arched thorax shaped like an opened ancient bell, tapering underside, exactly TWO immense lateral membranous fin-sails sweeping downward then upward at their tips. Each sail has an ivory/copper structural edge and large vermilion/navy paper membrane planes with ONE soft pleat near root. Root each fin in central thorax; NO feather bird wings, no many tendrils or human arms. A small head grows forward from upper thorax, mask-like living face with broad angular brow, TWO icy CYAN eyes with dark pupils and a small distinct jaw/mouth beneath, no beak, dog muzzle or human mask. Two swept-back short crescent head plates create a unique notched crown silhouette, not antlers. Creature feels wise and commanding, not a vehicle, toy manta or flying machine.
Armor is hanging layered nacre/ivory collar and curved dark navy breastplate on FRONT MIDLINE immediately under face. ONE pale-lilac CRYSTAL PIPA is seated at CENTER of breastplate on body's anatomical midline, not on a side fin. Preserve broad upper kite shoulders, long pointed lower tip with stepped lower notches, mint inner cross-spars and central woven knot; copper THREE claws grip lateral corners and lower point, top remains free. Three narrow lavender energy channels travel to fin ROOTS as air-pressure guidance, no wholebody flame. Unarmored underside has supple burgundy paper folds so body looks alive under armor. Back has one broad short layered shell, not giant horns or spikes. SINGLE complete long braided navy/ivory rabiola from rear ends in ONE red/ivory asymmetric folded pennant. No second soul. No legs or claws whatsoever, silhouette floats a little above its simple small shadow.
Color identity VERMILION, ivory, midnight navy, muted copper, pale lilac gem and CYAN EYES, never orange amber yellow eyes. 45% creature45% kite constructions10% crisp selective pixel-contour / 2D manga. Beautiful broad sculptural armor volumes with tight controlled detail, varied large-medium-small shapes, not ornate everywhere. Rich flat CEL SHADING 2-3 hard tones, dark confident outlines, no metallic 3D gloss, no painterly gradients, no realistic fish, no text. Entire full creature white LANDSCAPE canvas generous margins, all sail tips and tail visible.

creatures.name: Ofirante
creatures.architecture: Serpentino sem membros, tronco em espiras e placas que acompanham a curva.
creatures.story: Propõe-se que comprima as espiras para receber um impacto e mudar sua direção.
creatures.tradeoff: Precisa estabelecer uma base de apoio antes de redirecionar um golpe forte.
creatures.review: Corpo contínuo sem patas ou braços; cabeça de mandíbula e presas, olhos verdes e placas cervicais. Cristal na frente do pescoço, com núcleo e quilha alinhados. Uma cauda/rabiola. A sobreposição de espiras exige vista de produção antes de rig.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. Create ONE ORIGINAL adult SOULMONSTER OFIRANTE, ancient SERPENTINE bearer of the Crystais Pipas. Ref1 our crystal sheet ONLY exact artifact identity; ref2 original Vesperalito ONLY clean 2D manga finish and armor density, DO NOT COPY head mask, quadruped body, colors or chest silhouette. Entire LIMBLESS serpent in a compact powerful S-coil, NO legs, arms, wings, humanoid torso or canine head. Main coil supports an upright neck, a smaller folded outer coil sits forward; continuous body from head through coils to single tail. Head genuinely serpent-like: wide flat angular skull, small deep EMERALD GREEN eyes with vertical dark pupils, short blunt reptile snout, paired nostrils and a broad hinged lower jaw slightly parted exposing two folded fangs, no beak or mammal mouth, no orange eyes. Adult cunning presence, not cute cartoon snake. Head held low over upright chest, looking toward viewer from threequarter angle.
Body dark burgundy/plum living paper with large ivory segmented underside and black-red interleaved lamellae, not hundreds of tiny scales. Spectacular armor is broad lacquer-like but MATTE BLACKENED CRIMSON plates with ivory/copper edge, flexible gaps expose supple folded membranes. On upper neck exactly TWO broad swept collar plates flare BACK like a broken ceremonial gong, no cobra hood with eyes. They emerge from neck armor roots, not disconnected objects or horns. Body coil's outside has a few interlocking crescent shields aligned to bend, original richly layered design, restrained mint fasteners.
ONE pale lilac Crystal Pipa integrated into the FRONT MIDLINE of upright throat/pectoral armor just under jaw: wide upper corners, long lower point and stepped notches, mint internal frozen cross-spine and woven knot core, three copper prongs at two side corners and bottom, top exposed. Crystal is structurally cradled in armor, NOT a necklace, not floating, not mounted on outside of coil. Split armored throat halves converge into central keel aligned with crystal, perspective-consistent. Thin lavender channels pass UNDER collar and travel along lateral seams; no fire or glowing eyes everywhere.
Tail exits from outer rear coil clearly, narrows into ONE short burgundy/mint braided cord rabiola ending in a single ivory/crimson fork-cut paper pennant. No separate detached snake or second tail, one soul. Guarding movement suggests serpent can contract coil and redirect force, but keep anatomy continuous and countable.
45% creature45% living kite 10% selective stepped ink/2D manga. Rich black-crimson/ivory/dark plum/copper color identity, green eyes, lilac artifact; NOT Vesperalito's petrol palette. Sharp mature reptilian face and substantial armor volume, hierarchy of broad quiet forms and medium plates. Clean flat CEL SHADING, dark confident ink contours, 2-3 hard shadow planes, no realistic shiny metal, 3D rendering, paint texture, gradient or excessive origami folds. FULL creature white landscape canvas with 8% safe margins, no cropping no text no inset views.

creatures.name: Canticripta
creatures.architecture: Insetoide de seis membros: quatro patas e dois braços raptoriais; dois painéis dorsais.
creatures.story: Propõe-se que as câmaras dorsais modulem vibrações e os braços interrompam linhas tensionadas.
creatures.tradeoff: Dobrar os painéis para defesa reduz a capacidade de modular as vibrações.
creatures.review: Tentativa inicial apresentou seis patas mais dois braços. Correção dirigida retirou o par intermediário; imagem final conferida com quatro patas e dois braços, duas antenas e dois painéis dorsais. Cristal no eixo do protórax, olhos compostos magenta e uma rabiola. A ação sonora não foi animada.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. ONE original adult SOULMONSTER CANTICRIPTA, an ancient INSECTOID bearer of the CRYSTAIS PIPAS. Ref1 our crystal design sheet for same signature gem; Ref2 original Vesperalito for rich clean2D manga armor rendering ONLY, DO NOT COPY quadruped body, humanoid mask, leg design or petrol palette.
Distinct original anatomy blends mantis, resonating lantern and a folded ceremonial kite-organ. EXACTLY SIX LIMBS total: FOUR slender ARMORED WALKING LEGS (two on each side of abdomen), plus TWO raised raptorial forelimbs rooted in prothorax, each ending in a long broad inward-folding ivory PAPER-REED BLADE. These forelimbs are not swords held in hands, no human hands. Show all four walking legs separately with grounded pointed threepronged feet and clear insect joints; two forelimbs above them. NO seventh limb, no human legs, no mammal paws. Long low flexible black-indigo abdomen, narrow tall prothorax carries small TRIANGULAR insect head with TWO rounded angular compound eyes of deep MAGENTA with small pale facets (no orange amber yellow eyes). Face has small paired mandibles at lower edge and no nose, no teeth grin, no mammal brow mask. Two thin curved ivory antennae with one mint ring each rise from head, clearly NOT arms.
Striking dorsal identity: TWO very tall closed split-ELYTRON panels rise from rear thorax at a steep angle like an opened paper organ cabinet, black-indigo with broad jade membranes and ivory stepped outer ridges. Exactly two panels with their clear roots, no extra bird wings or random spires. Inside each panel THREE broad elongated pale membrane chambers like wind reeds, not literal metal pipes. Adult presence, beautiful controlled complexity, don't turn into robot or cathedral building. Soft living violet membrane and folds at abdomen/joints contrast broad rigid lamellae.
ONE pale-lilac CRYSTAL PIPA physically cradled on FRONT MIDLINE of elongated prothorax beneath head, align nucleus and bottom tip with sternum between raptorial limb roots, never lateral shoulder or wing. Same wide kite upper corners, elongated pointed lower end with stepped notches, mint cross-spar woven knot center; copper THREE-prong mount sides+bottom, top free. Small lavender channels pass to elytron bases. No crystal eyes or second gem. One SINGLE thin segmented abdominal tail at rear tapers to mint/black cord and ONE long pleated ivory/jade pennant, fully attached rabiola. No other tails.
Pose like silent conductor poised before strike, one forelimb raised more than other, head looking down at viewer, four walking feet anchor stable. 45% living insect creature45% kite material10% crisp selective pixel-contour 2D manga. Palette black-indigo, vivid jade, ivory, muted copper, violet soft body; MAGENTA insect eyes, lilac crystal. Flat matte colors2-3 hard cel shadows, dark confident line art, sculptural armor overlap and middle-scale details. No photoreal insect, no glossy metal or 3D, no painterly gradients, no aura hiding joints, no text or inset. Entire creature on WHITE LANDSCAPE canvas, broad margins around antennae, both dorsal panels, claws and tail.
creatures.edit_prompt:
Anatomy correction of this original insect Soulmonster Canticripta. Keep identity, head compound magenta eyes, two antennae, jade organ-elytra, crystal on sternum, armor palette, two raised scythe forelimbs and single tail. The existing drawing has SIX walking feet PLUS two raised scythes = EIGHT limbs, which is WRONG. Final design must have EXACTLY FOUR walking legs PLUS TWO raptorial forelimbs = SIX limbs total.

DELETE the INTERMEDIATE PAIR of walking legs entirely, from their root to tip: specifically remove the foot around image x610,y895 and its leg upward to belly, and remove the large middle foreground foot around x780,y945 and its leg upward to abdomen. Replace their former root areas with clean continuous violet abdominal membrane and armor overlap, and restore plain white space and correct simple ground shadow where the deleted feet were. These two removed legs must NOT leave stumps or detached claws. DO NOT add substitute limbs.

KEEP the FRONT walking pair: large lower-left foot around x145,y950 and smaller foot around x370,y890. KEEP the REAR walking pair: large lower-right foot around x1180,y950 and smaller foot around x1000,y890. Keep their roots continuous and leg joints coherent. Keep TWO separate raised raptorial arms, one high at viewer-left, one folded near center. Exactly FOUR ground contacts and TWO scythes, no other feet.

Show slightly more gap beneath abdomen so the four surviving legs can be counted. Keep two antennae above head, two dorsal elytron panels, single attached rabiola tail. Crystal remains exactly on anatomical prothorax midline under head with three-prong mount. Clean crisp 2D manga flat colors and hard cel shadows; preserve background white, no new text or objects. Change only the anatomy/white gaps necessary for this correction.
